heroIntro: In property and land litigation, securing a Temporary Injunction or Status Quo order under Order 39 Rules 1 & 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure 1908 (CPC) is vital to restrain unauthorized construction, dispossession, or alienation pending suit adjudication. Authored by Advocate Md. Shah Alam, Supreme Court Advocate. Call our Uttara chamber at 01712655546.

quickAnswer.heading: ⚡ 3 Golden Principles for Granting Temporary Injunction
points: Prima Facie Case: Strong initial legal title and documentary evidence supporting the plaintiff rights.
Irreparable Loss: Proof that refusal of injunction will cause harm that monetary damages cannot remedy.
Balance of Convenience: Greater comparative hardship on the plaintiff if relief is denied than on the defendant if granted.

sections.heading: 1. Legal Definition: Injunction & Status Quo under Civil Law
sections.content: An injunction is a preventive equitable relief preserving the subject-matter in dispute intact until rights are finally determined on merit.

sections.heading: 2. The Three Cardinal Tests for Injunction (Order 39 CPC)
sections.content: The Court exercises judicial discretion by evaluating: (1) Prima facie arguable case, (2) Irreparable injury, and (3) Balance of convenience.

sections.heading: 3. Urgent Ex-Parte Ad-Interim Injunctions
sections.content: When immediate unauthorized demolition or dispossession is imminent, courts grant ex-parte ad-interim injunctions pending show-cause notice hearing.

sections.heading: 4. Penal Consequences for Disobeying Injunction (Civil Imprisonment)
sections.content: Under Order 39 Rule 2A CPC, deliberate violation of an injunction order is punishable with civil imprisonment up to 6 months and property attachment.

sections.heading: 5. Court Fee Structure and Document Checklist
sections.content: Requires land registration deeds, khatians, municipal tax receipts, Dakhilas, and verified affidavit under Order 19 CPC.

sections.heading: 6. Appellate Remedies: Misc Appeal & Civil Revision under Section 115 CPC
sections.content: Orders refusing or granting injunction are appealable before the District Judge under Order 43 Rule 1(r) CPC, with further revisional jurisdiction in the High Court Division under Section 115 CPC.

sections.heading: 7. Supreme Court Civil Consultation
sections.content: For urgent civil injunction applications and High Court stays, contact Advocate Md. Shah Alam at 01712655546.

faq.question: How quickly can an emergency stay order be obtained?
faq.answer: In urgent situations, an ad-interim injunction can be argued and obtained within 24 to 48 hours of filing.
